ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima 'Contagious Interview' coding-test chain — node.exe spawning Python/pip (BeaverTail → InvisibleFerret)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature DPRK fake-job malware chain where a victim developer runs a malicious npm/Node coding assignment (BeaverTail, JavaScript) that drops and launches a Python backdoor (InvisibleFerret) to steal browser credentials and crypto wallets. The node.exe → python.exe/pip parent-child relationship launched from a user staging folder is highly specific to Famous Chollima (a.k.a. Famous Chollima / UNC5342 / 'Contagious Interview').
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="node.exe") AND (Processes.process_name IN ("python.exe","pythonw.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_name Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where like(parent_process,"%\\Downloads\\%") OR like(parent_process,"%\\Desktop\\%") OR like(parent_process,"%\\Temp\\%") OR like(parent_process,"%\\AppData\\%") OR like(process,"%pip%install%") OR like(process,"%http%")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process process process_name count
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("python.exe","pythonw.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
// node coding-test launched from a user staging dir, or child pulling a payload / pip-installing
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Desktop\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\")
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("pip install","http://","https://","-c ","DownloadString","base64")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\node.exe"
| extend ChildName = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ChildName in~ ("python.exe","pythonw.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Desktop\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\")
   or CommandLine has_any ("pip install","http://","https://","DownloadString","base64")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

status: experimental
description: Detects node.exe (malicious npm coding-test / BeaverTail) spawning a Python interpreter or pip, characteristic of the DPRK Contagious Interview chain dropping InvisibleFerret.
references:
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/blog/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/25
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1105
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\node.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
      - '\pip.exe'
      - '\pip3.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Node toolchains that shell out to Python build scripts (node-gyp). Tune by parent folder path.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\node.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE) @Image:(*\python.exe OR *\Python.exe OR *\pythonw.exe OR *\pip.exe OR *\pip3.exe OR *\curl.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/node\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(python|pythonw|pip|pip3|curl|powershell)\.exe$/i

| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentImageFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima ClickFix interview lure — explorer/browser-driven paste of PowerShell/mshta download cradle
ucs.description: Hunts the DPRK 'ClickFix' variant of Contagious Interview where a fake interview / 'fix your camera or browser' page instructs the victim to paste a command into the Run dialog or terminal, executing a remote download cradle. Targets the user-copy-paste-execution technique (T1204.004) with an explorer.exe-spawned interpreter pulling a remote payload.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where like(process,"%iwr%") OR like(process,"%Invoke-WebRequest%") OR like(process,"%IEX%") OR like(process,"%Invoke-Expression%") OR like(process,"%DownloadString%") OR like(process,"%curl %http%") OR like(process,"%certutil%-urlcache%") OR like(process,"%mshta%http%") OR like(process,"%FromBase64String%") OR like(process,"%-enc %")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process process_name count
| sort - lastTime

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Famous Chollima ClickFix - explorer or browser spawning download cradle
id: b9e1f3d2-6c44-4f8a-8e21-2a7d9c1b3f60
status: experimental
description: Detects a PowerShell/cmd/mshta/curl/certutil download cradle spawned by explorer.exe (Run dialog paste) or a browser, the execution footprint of the DPRK Contagious Interview ClickFix lure.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1204/004/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/25
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.004
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1218
  - attack.t1105
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
  selection_cradle:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'iwr'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - '-urlcache'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - '-enc'
      - 'http'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cradle
falsepositives:
  - Admin one-liners pasted into Run by IT staff. Scope to non-admin users / known-good source domains.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe OR *\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\firefox.exe) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\cmd.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\curl.exe OR *\certutil.exe) @CommandLine:(*iwr* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *IEX* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *DownloadString* OR *-urlcache* OR *FromBase64String* OR *-enc* OR *http*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(explorer|chrome|msedge|firefox|brave)\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|mshta|curl|certutil)\.exe$/i
| regex("(iwr|Invoke-WebRequest|IEX|Invoke-Expression|DownloadString|-urlcache|FromBase64String|-enc|https?://)", field=CommandLine, flags=i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Famous Chollima pivoted its Contagious Interview lures to ClickFix, instructing developers on fake interview/conferencing pages to paste a 'fix' command into the Run dialog — yielding an explorer.exe (or browser) parent for a PowerShell/mshta/curl download cradle. Pairing the unusual interactive-paste parent with a remote-fetch command line distinguishes this DPRK tradecraft from benign scripting
